title: SpaceX Raised $86 Billion and OpenAI Is Next. This ETF Owns the IPO Class of 2026

summary: SpaceX's blockbuster listing cracked open the 2026 IPO window, and Anthropic and OpenAI are already circling the runway. One ETF positions investors across the entire cohort, but its five-year track record reveals a tension that could define the next rebalance.

summary: Stocks are subdued in early trading, while crude oil is bouncing between positive and negative territory. Gold and silver are mixed, while the dollar and Treasuries are flatlining.

title: U.S. IPO Market Has More Room to Rally in H2 2026: ETFs Poised to Win
